information_clock: end of latest completed hourly bar
decision_clock: hypothetical bar_end + 1 nanosecond; historical publication delay unknown
label_clock: bar_end to bar_end + 1 hour; idealized forecasting label, not an executable fill
architecture: existing one pre-norm block, exact GELU, fixed window-relative sinusoidal positions, final layer norm; dropout zero
split_policy: label end is strictly after split start and at or before split end; past input context may precede the split; never shuffle across splits
scaler: population mean/std of training input rows only; constant feature scale=1; frozen embedded FP32
initialization: seeded Xavier body; zero head weights and bias chosen for training-label mean; epoch 0 is an eligible constant candidate
selection: earliest lowest validation MSE among epochs 0..3; all seeds sealed before test evaluation
ridge_objective: mean squared residual + alpha * squared coefficients; train-only feature centering/scaling and unpenalized intercept
ridge_selection: lowest validation MSE; first alpha wins ties

uncertainty.method: paired circular moving-block bootstrap of squared-error difference

descriptive_gate: all three selected models beat zero and selected ridge on test MSE, and primary-seed paired mean loss-difference interval lies below zero; passing would still be exploratory
stopping: exactly three seeds and three training epochs; no outcome-dependent extension or feature search
test_policy: chronological reused QTS history; all choices frozen before scoring; no untouched program holdout
limitations: no executable quotes, fees or trading P&L
